story_overview: Following a tense consultation where Arthur speaks with an anguished nurse named Eleanor, various individuals move about a grand infirmary. Julian and Simon have serious conversations with Arthur and Lena, watched by nurses Eleanor and Gwen. The story involves mysterious arrivals and departures by car, suggesting a clandestine operation is underway.

The Consultation Room: Clinical office or interview room with a professional office desk that has a small white box on its surface.
the white dress shirt: White, long-sleeved, button-front dress shirt with a collar.
the charcoal silk tie: Dark charcoal grey silk necktie with a standard width and a subtle woven texture.
